risks: Acquisition-led expansion introduces integration, regulatory-close and capital-allocation risk; announced addressable markets are not equivalent to captured revenue.

Acquisition integration and capital allocation can dilute platform benefits.
Tariffs and policy shifts can compress margins or delay customer projects.
Backlog can overstate near-term economic realization if schedules slip or project economics weaken.
Tariffs, policy shifts, backlog conversion and acquisition integration can weaken realized economics.
